gaps.impact: The first four modes realized only three PC/BDCC combinations, so independence was unsupported.
gaps.repair: Added remote/isolated action with overt directive/closure use but no selected endpoint-to-bearer path; reran 160 rows.
gaps.unresolved: Real-system realization of the isolated mode remains an empirical grounding question.

gaps.impact: Without same-instance carrier, consumer, timing, boundary, and intervention evidence, BDCC is only an abstract typed relation.
gaps.counterexample: A test may activate a reserve or neighboring route unused in the target episode.
gaps.repair: Definition separates actual path membership from test evidence and requires target-specific grounding.
gaps.unresolved: No complete biological or artificial installation is supplied.

gaps.impact: PC+BDCC does not identify felt agency, trying, ownership, or familiar mineness.
gaps.counterexample: Reflex twin preserves the full declared profile.
gaps.repair: Downgraded the conclusion to bearer-involving practical organization and retained non-identification.
gaps.unresolved: An independent online conflict/endorsement transformation, if any, needs definition and a non-report discriminator.

gaps.impact: A selected profile is not complete ontic organization and does not determine subject count or exclusive ownership.
gaps.counterexample: Overlapping local and whole processes can share routes while copies can share abstract profiles.
gaps.repair: Restricted every claim to fixed targets/instances and retained UCT overlap doctrine.
gaps.unresolved: No global subject-boundary theorem is attempted.

gaps.impact: Explicit ratings, drift, intentional binding, MEPs, and autonomic signals diverge and cannot be collapsed into one target.
gaps.counterexample: Critchley et al. report illusion evidence with null sustained autonomic differences; Hong et al. report divergent embodiment measures.
gaps.repair: Evidence is used only as constraint and motivation, not as a phenomenal identity proof.
gaps.unresolved: No independent direct measure of familiar mineness is available.
